title: Position: A Roadmap to Pluralistic Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the probability distributions of LLM multiple-choice responses on the GlobalOpinionQA dataset to target human population survey distributions (e.g., US, Japan, Germany) using Jensen-Shannon distance.

Evaluating the reduction of distributional pluralism by comparing LLM response distributions on the Machine Personality Inventory (MPI) to global human personality trait distributions, utilizing Jensen-Shannon distance and entropy calculations.
